properties.text: A Russian milblogger claimed that Russian forces advanced northeast of Serhiivka and south of Raipole (both southwest of Dobropillya).[51] Ukrainian strikes appear to be creating morale and logistics problems within Russian units and inhibiting Russian advances in the Dobropillya direction.

[34] A Russian milblogger claimed that Russian forces advanced west of Odradne (east of Velykyi Burluk).[35] Russian milbloggers continue to make spurious claims about an encirclement in northeastern Kharkiv Oblast.

Russian Subordinate Main Effort #2 – Advance on the Fortress Belt from the east Russian objective: Advance on Slovyansk, Kramatorsk, and Druzhkivka from the east – assessed objective of the Russian 3rd Combined Arms Army and Southern Grouping of Forces elements Russian forces recently conducted an infiltration mission near Chasiv Yar.
